name: Nocturnal-Antiphon

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near impact-scarred wastelands that no expedition has ever claimed.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Regular pulses leave the monolithic structures of unknown origin aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
